Legal

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: July 2026

These Terms & Conditions govern the booking and provision of event planning, coordination, and management services by Utsah Events ("Utsah", "we", "us") to any client ("you") engaging our services for a wedding, corporate event, or other celebration. By confirming a booking with us, you agree to these terms.

1. Our Services

Utsah Events provides end-to-end event planning and coordination, including but not limited to venue selection, décor, vendor management, entertainment, logistics, and on-ground execution for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, baby showers, and other celebrations. The exact scope of services for your event will be confirmed in a written proposal or quotation before booking.

2. Bookings & Payments

A booking is confirmed only once an agreed advance/token amount has been paid. The remaining balance is payable as per the schedule outlined in your proposal, typically with milestone payments leading up to the event date and final settlement on or before the event. Prices quoted are specific to the scope, date, and guest count discussed, and may be revised if these change.

3. Cancellations & Rescheduling

We understand plans can change. Cancellation or rescheduling requests must be made in writing. Advance payments already made to secure vendors, venues, or bookings on your behalf are generally non-refundable, as these amounts are often committed to third parties ahead of your event. Any refundable portion, if applicable, will depend on how far in advance the request is made and the cancellation terms of the vendors involved. We will always work with you in good faith to minimise loss wherever possible.

4. Client Responsibilities

To help us deliver your event successfully, you agree to provide accurate and timely information (guest counts, preferences, timelines, budgets), respond promptly to approvals, and inform us of any changes as early as possible. Delays in providing information may affect our ability to execute certain elements of the event as planned.

5. Vendors & Third Parties

We work with a trusted network of venues, caterers, decorators, entertainers, and other vendors. While we manage these relationships on your behalf, certain vendors may have their own terms and conditions which will be shared with you where relevant. Utsah Events is not liable for delays or shortcomings that are solely the fault of an independent third-party vendor, though we will always act promptly to resolve issues on your behalf.

6. Liability

Utsah Events takes every reasonable precaution to ensure your event runs smoothly. However, we are not liable for circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to weather, venue restrictions, government regulations, or acts of third parties. Our liability for any claim relating to our services is limited to the amount paid to us for that specific event.

7. Force Majeure

Neither party will be held responsible for delay or failure to perform obligations due to events beyond reasonable control, including natural disasters, government action, public health emergencies, or other unforeseeable circumstances. In such cases, we will work with you to reschedule or adjust plans wherever possible.

8. Photography, Video & Promotional Use

With your consent, photographs and videos from your event may be used by Utsah Events for portfolio, marketing, and social media purposes. If you would prefer that images from your event not be used publicly, please let us know in writing before your event date and we will honour that request.

9. Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time to reflect changes in our services or applicable law. The version in effect at the time of your booking will govern that engagement.

10. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and any disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts in Surat, Gujarat.

If you have any questions about these Terms & Conditions, please reach out to us at sales@utsahevents.com or +91 82003 95197.
